set.body:
Problem (edcdfd5): no fit-to-width or ellipsis helper exists in core, svg, javafx or interaction (search for ellipsis/truncate/elide finds none outside tests). Every consumer that labels narrow columns re-implements measure-and-trim.

General use: narrow table headers, legend entries and axis labels. Consumer example: PLS Neuro model studio cell-group labels truncate with an ellipsis and tooltip when they exceed the header budget (spec section 2.3); the fallback policy (full, 3-letter, initial) stays with the caller.

Acceptance:
- Given a TextMetrics, a text style and a width, return the full label when it fits, otherwise the longest grapheme-safe prefix plus "…" that fits, and report whether it was truncated.
- Deterministic with the estimate provider; tested against Java2D, JavaFX (once available) and Canvas metrics.
- Works for rotated labels when combined with the rotated-extent measurement.

Out of scope: multi-line wrapping, middle elision, abbreviation policy.
Depends on: JavaFX-backed TextMetrics (sibling issue) for JavaFX accuracy.
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 for PLS Neuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F.
set.title: [Intaglio][Text] Fit-to-width text helper with ellipsis
